Two mechanisms of opposite sign are both present: latent-mixture common-mode is strictly optimistic by Jensen, while fixed-weight negative association is pessimistic. The distortion reduces to the joint moment mu_m at m = delta_e+1, NOT to pairwise correlation, and mu_m is not determined by mu_2 - so second-moment data is STRUCTURALLY INCAPABLE of signing it, and all published evidence is second-moment.
